Every scene has its own floor: honeycomb, square, diamond, triangle and round holes. Put it on, relax, and watch it all come back together.

Which one was the most satisfying? Tell me the timestamp in the comments 👇

rss.desc:
1 marble… 10… 100… 500… 10,000 rainbow glass marbles! How many can one electromagnet lift? 🧲🌈
Every marble is a real physics simulation: they rain into a steel tray, get pulled into one giant glass ball and crash back down, with a glass clink for every hit.

Which round was the most satisfying? Tell me in the comments 👇

Made in Blender (Cycles + rigid body physics). All sounds are generated from the simulation.
